rows.note: Use this for the period during which someone serves as president.

example.english: Their presidency has two years left.
example.traditional: 佢嘅總統任期仲有兩年先完。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 zung2 tung2 jam6 kei4 zung6 jau5 loeng5 nin4 sin1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for the office or role of president.

example.english: The opposition parties are competing for the presidency.
example.traditional: 反對黨爭住競逐總統職位。
example.jyutping: faan2 deoi3 dong2 zaang1 zyu6 ging3 zuk6 zung2 tung2 zik1 wai6

rows.note: Use this for the president's team and administration rather than the constitutional office itself.

example.english: After the new president took office, the presidency introduced several new policies.
example.traditional: 新總統上台之後，總統班底推出咗幾項新政策。
example.jyutping: san1 zung2 tung2 soeng6 toi1 zi1 hau6 zung2 tung2 baan1 dai2 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 gei2 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3
